review_scope.reviewer: Codex agent linguistic review; not native-human annotation
review_scope.all_cases: All 1550 receive structural, unusual-character, duplicate-input, source-alignment and optional reading-table/analyzer checks. Analyzer disagreements never automatically change labels.
review_scope.focused_review: All 26 original table-unsupported items; all 63 Tatoeba items with ASCII letters/digits or numeric characters; 197 nonnumeric Tatoeba analyzer disagreements screened, retaining valid alternatives and analyzer errors; AJIMEE analyzer disagreements screened.
review_scope.not_claimed: No claim of exhaustive human verification of every reading or of completeness of every acceptable-spelling list. Remaining uncertainty is recorded separately.
review_scope.prediction_independence: Corrections use original text/transcription, lexical evidence and linguistic context, not the spelling preferred by the conversion model. The historical 1550-case file remains immutable.

additional_review_note: Six initially uncertain readings resolved from original context and dictionary evidence. Old baseline snippets were incidentally seen while locating sources, but were not used as linguistic evidence. New sealed evaluation predictions were not consulted.
